prompt: Create a serene, high-resolution vertical poster featuring a miniature diorama scene set on a wet, reflective stone surface. The focal point is a celadon green tea bowl filled with tea, positioned next to a small, mossy stone arch bridge. A delicate white lotus flower rests at the base of the bowl. Tiny miniature figures (approx. 6 people) are scattered around: some standing taking photos, one sitting on the bridge, and others walking. Suspended from the top center is a thin string holding a translucent green leaf pendant with a water droplet at its tip, hanging directly above the tea bowl. The background is a soft, out-of-focus blur of light grey and beige tones. In the upper right corner, overlay elegant typography in Chinese and English: '早安' (Good Morning) in large brown serif font, '杭州' (Hangzhou) in dark green serif font, followed by 'HANGZHOU GOOD MORNING', the date '2026-10-20', weather info '天气：晴转雷阵雨 22-32°C', and a poetic quote '今日金句：心有清风，步步自有回响。'. Use a macro photography style with shallow depth of field.

promptZh: 创作一张宁静雅致的高清竖版海报，画面主体为微缩景观场景，置于湿润且带有倒影的石面上。视觉焦点是一只盛满茶水的青瓷茶碗，旁边紧挨着一座长满青苔的小型石拱桥。一朵洁白的莲花静静倚靠在茶碗底部。周围散落着约 6 个微缩人偶：有的正站着拍照，一个坐在桥上，其余的则在漫步。画面顶部中央垂下一根细线，悬挂着一枚半透明的绿色树叶吊坠，叶尖缀着一颗水滴，正好悬于茶碗正上方。背景采用柔和的虚化处理，呈现浅灰与米色交织的朦胧色调。右上角叠加中英文优雅排版：大号棕色衬线字体的“早安”，深绿色衬线字体的“杭州”，下方依次为“HANGZHOU GOOD MORNING”、日期“2026-10-20”、天气信息“天气：晴转雷阵雨 22-32°C”，以及诗意金句“今日金句：心有清风，步步自有回响。”。整体采用微距摄影风格，营造浅景深效果。
